deskyard help: help for a command

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] help [COMMAND...]

Prints help for a command, or the overview. Same as COMMAND --help.

Arguments:
  COMMAND    string...   optional  command name, e.g. click or remote add

Prints: help text

Examples:
  deskyard help cp

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
